notes.title: Our game is participating in the IGDX Game Showcase Event 2023
notes.notes:
Our game is participating in the Indonesia Game Developer eXchange (IGDX) Game Showcase Event from October 11th to 15th, 2023. Many games from Indonesia are gathered here; come and play our game demo.
*Our newest demo is available for download until October 15th, 2023, so don't miss it.

notes.title: Our Game Development Progress: Reworking Story and Tilesets
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to share an update on our game development progress. Currently, our focus is on reworking the story and tilesets for the game. We believe that these updates will greatly enhance the player experience and create a more immersive world.

We have been hard at work crafting a new story that builds upon the original concept while adding more depth and complexity. The new narrative will take players on a journey through a rich and vibrant world, filled with interesting characters, compelling plot twists, and memorable moments.

In addition to the story, we are also reworking the tilesets to better reflect the game's theme and setting. Our goal is to create an environment that feels alive and beautiful visuals that transport players to another world.

We will be sharing more information about the demo game soon, once we have updated the content on our store page on Steam. We want to ensure that our fans have the most accurate and up-to-date information about our game.

Thank you for your support and patience as we continue to work on the development of our game. We are excited to share our progress with you, and we hope you are as excited as we are for the final product.

Best regards,

ADN Production Team
